name: Adhesive Remover

features.text: Has no adverse effect on paint when used as directed.
Caution should be taken on new paint.
Wipes away clean, will not gum-up.
Dries quickly, leaving a clean surface without residue.

description: A clear, highly aromatic solvent formulated to remove adhesive left behind from masking-tape removal. It works fast and dries quickly. Caution: Liquid and vapor are flammable.
application: 1.) Use only in well-ventilated areas. 2.) Saturate clean cloth with remover. 3.) Use brisk motion and remove. 4.) Wipe dry with a clean rag. 5.) Be careful on new paint; may damage paint or plastic.
